comparison.objective: Transfer drives from a failed server to identical bay numbers in a replacement chassis, rather than finish inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Bay identification, drive unlatching/extraction, ordered transfer, insertion, and relatching versus bimanual impact tooling and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Title requires preservation of bay-number mapping in the replacement chassis; no drive count, latch verification, or complete rubric is available. Tang fracture and insert protection are absent.
comparison.reason: Mapped module transfer and latching are materially different from controlled fracture and recovery.
